title: INTERPRETING LANGUAGE REWARD MODELS VIA CONTRASTIVE EXPLANATIONS
reasoning: The paper evaluates Reward Models (RMs) based on their alignment with human values and safety. It uses high-level evaluation attributes like 'harmlessness' (defined by immoral or illegal behaviors) and 'neutrality' (defined by lack of bias towards certain groups) to analyze model behavior, including qualitative case studies on ethical dilemmas such as dog fighting.
